x_notes.record: per-project append-only JSONL, path named by each harness binding; never shipped. Read and written only on an instrumented run (doctrine RT-9). Sole writer = the binding's probe procedure; a run never writes back (doctrine RT-4).
x_notes.selection: consumable row = latest matching harness + config_hash + model_gen; no match = re-probe (append, never edit). Malformed or unreadable = ERROR, conservative-closed. Selector: scripts/probe-select.py
x_notes.boot_tokens: the harness's fixed context-establishment overhead, in raw tokens; tier-agnostic
